notes: System ceilings and floors for the budgets a model writes. The Goal Manager and the Planner propose; the runners clamp into these limits and report every adjustment before the user approves.
Goal budgets are clamped by run-goal.mjs after the Goal Manager returns. Contract budgets are clamped by the orchestrator when the contract is sealed; the plan file keeps the Planner's numbers.
max_builder_attempts.direct enforces CODE_GENERATION_FLOW §8.1: the direct route allows at most two attempts.
Floors: max_research_calls is raised to the number of required pending research questions, so a deliberation can never end without researching what the Goal says it needs.
